----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- no readiness = no PaymentIntent/charge;
- one idempotency key = at most one charge, entitlement and delivery;
- amount/currency/VAT/SKU/account consistent across provider/ledger/receipt/invoice;
- entitlement only after confirmed payment;
- account/tier/surface/case binding cannot be swapped;
- delayed delivery follows retry/comms/refund policy;
- invalid/replayed webhook cannot mutate state;
- support cannot hide financial discrepancy;
- refund right and complaint path cannot be blocked by fraud control;
- no reviewer/capacity/data/right = stop-sell before charge.

HG07 PASS

19. EVIDENCE GOVERNANCE, TTL I CRYPTOGRAPHIC BINDING

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source/build                         exact artifact; any change invalidates

IAM/RLS/security                     90 dni lub material change/incident
legal/privacy/DPA                    180 dni lub region/dataflow/subprocessor/SKU change

20. INDEPENDENT ASSURANCE, BENCHMARK I DURABLE ADVANTAGE
====================================================================================================

INDEPENDENT SCOPE
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SR00/FG00 integrity; security/cloud/IAM/RLS; data rights/accuracy/failover; AI/risk; audit methodology;
accessibility/browser/PDF; payment/refund; vendor exit; economics/retention; peer set/moat; evidence chain.

Reviewer:
- qualified, no conflict, exact frozen artifact/data/config;
- raw findings retained;
- no management override without public risk acceptance;
- retest after fixes;
- signed TTL and triggers.

BEST-BASELINE BENCHMARK
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Peer set preregistered before results and includes:
- best available competing product;
- customer current manual/workflow alternative;
- Velmère Basic;
- qualified human expert where relevant.

Dataset frozen, unseen, stratified by language/asset/chain/regime/edge case. Reviewer blind to names and
order randomized. Measure product-specific primary outcome, quality, safety, time, actionability and cost.

DURABLE ADVANTAGE REGISTER
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
For each alleged moat:
advantage, customer value, legal owner, evidence, dependency, maintenance, copy cost/time, substitute
risk after loss of model/provider/partner, expiry and renewal owner.

Acceptable candidates:
- lawful proprietary/licensed data;
- evidence graph and provenance corpus;
- high-quality eval/adjudication dataset;
- methodology and reviewer network;
- deep workflow integration and trust record;
- learning loop using lawful customer feedback.

Dark patterns, artificial lock-in and withholding customer data are not moat.

29. OSTATECZNA ZASADA PASS35
====================================================================================================

Velmère nie zostaje topką świata przez liczbę modułów, passów, plików, testów fixture, długość PDF-u,
ładny UI ani deklarowany budżet. Zostaje topowym produktem wtedy, gdy dokładnie zdefiniowany klient w
dokładnie zdefiniowanym workflow otrzymuje bezpieczny, legalny, odtwarzalny i mierzalnie lepszy outcome
niż najlepsza dostępna alternatywa — na exact artefakcie, w realnej produkcji, przez pełne okno, z
niezależnym potwierdzeniem, uczciwą ekonomią, retencją i przewagą odporną na zmianę providera/modelu.

Dla „topki wszędzie” tę samą prawdę trzeba powtórzyć dla każdej aktywnie oferowanej komórki produktu.
Nie wolno rozszerzyć claimu o ani jeden tier, region, język, asset, chain, provider, model lub release,
którego nie obejmuje aktualny evidence packet. Brak dowodu oznacza NO-GO, nie „prawie gotowe”.

Pierwszy właściwy następny krok nie brzmi „dodaj kolejne funkcje”. Brzmi:
1. dokończyć SR00 przez niezależną weryfikację clean-machine i podpisanie finalnych hashy;
2. przejść FG00 i wybrać jeden flagship product-cell;
3. zamrozić PC00/ORG00;
4. doprowadzić ten jeden cell przez K0 -> K1 -> LIVE -> BENCHMARK -> RETENTION;
5. dopiero potem kopiować udowodniony system do kolejnych komórek.

Authority revision:
VELMERE_PASS36_A102R44_ACTION_REQUIRED_FINAL_UI_POLISH_EXACT_BUILD_BROWSER_AND_CLEAN_HANDOFF_NO_LIVE_CREDIT

VELMERE_PASS36_A102R43_ACTION_REQUIRED_FINAL_UI_UX_PERFORMANCE_HARDENING_AND_BLOCKED_FAULT_EMULATION_NO_LIVE_CREDIT

Scope is deliberately bounded to the user's final visible UI findings, route/data truth, exact local build/browser verification and clean handoff. No broad new visual redesign is admitted.

Findings and disposition:

- UI-R44-001 | P2 | FIXED_LOCAL | Shield Pro globe sat too low and exposed too little geographical detail. The globe is raised at desktop/mobile breakpoints; the existing 16,000-point real-land dataset is validated strictly and sampled more densely within bounded mobile/desktop budgets. Positive: one stable canvas with recognizable geography. Negative: invalid/out-of-budget geography rejects to the static fallback. Remaining truth: dataset provenance is not independent assurance.
- UI-R44-002 | P2 | FIXED_LOCAL | Velmère Browser displayed redundant ambient card and form outlines around the intended search pill. The outer shells are now transparent, borderless and shadowless through a last-imported bounded override. Positive: one intended search outline. Negative: no extra ambient border or shadow.
- UI-R44-003 | P1 | FIXED_LOCAL | Audit header light controls blended into the light audit background. The simplified audit header now has an explicit opaque #060709 surface with readable light brand/actions. Positive: header is visually separated. Negative: it does not inherit transparent global-header styling.
- UI-R44-004 | P1 | FIXED_LOCAL | Next/React Link prevented the document bubble handler before the transition veil began, causing post-commit flashes and perceived lag. The single transition owner now intercepts eligible internal clicks in capture phase and removes the same listener on cleanup. Positive: veil begins before router.push. Negative: data-no-route-transition remains an explicit opt-out and non-plain/external clicks are not intercepted.
- UI-R44-005 | P1 | FIXED_LOCAL | Failed catalog refresh could retain old rows while leaving a LIVE label. Both Shield Pro and Real Markets now preserve rows only as LAST_KNOWN_GOOD/STALE; local demo/reference rows remain REFERENCE. Positive: honest retained-data state. Negative: refresh failure cannot retain LIVE.
- UI-R44-006 | P2 | FIXED_LOCAL | Catalog client parsed non-2xx JSON but did not explicitly bind HTTP failure, reducing diagnostic truth. Non-2xx responses now stop the bounded catalog and preserve the sanitized blocker. Positive: api_canonical_origin_not_configured is surfaced. Negative: 503 cannot become empty LIVE data.
- UI-R44-008 | P1 | FIXED_LOCAL | Physical Shield testing found unavailable provider metrics rendered as numeric zero values, which could be mistaken for observed market data. Loading, empty and failed non-reference states now withhold all four KPI claims as em dashes, preserve the unavailable label and suppress derived sparkline/progress output. Positive: unavailable Shield state contains no numeric KPI claim. Negative: unavailable provider state cannot display 0, 0.00% or 0% as an observation. Remaining truth: no provider-currentness, real-data or LIVE credit.
- UI-R44-009 | P1 | FIXED_LOCAL | Physical Real Markets testing found a 0% active-instruments KPI while the provider had returned no verified risk values. The percentage and progress accent are now withheld until verified values exist. Positive: provider-unavailable state shows an em dash and unavailable label.
